title: Waldorf Astoria Residences Portfolio Set to Nearly Triple by 2030
summary: Momentum builds across the luxury Branded Residential by Hilton portfolio with new signings, landmark sales and construction milestones.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Momentum builds across the luxury Branded Residential by Hilton portfolio with new signings, landmark sales and construction milestones across the world’s most desirable locations


- **Waldorf Astoria Residences is set to nearly triple by 2030, with standout momentum across global markets.**
- **Key milestones include record penthouse sales in **St. Petersburg**** **and** **Pompano Beach, with the latter now 90% sold.**
- **The portfolio is expanding into landmark destinations, from Mexico, the Caribbean and Latin America to Miami’s future tallest residential tower on the East Coast outside New York City.**


**MCLEAN, Va.** – Today,[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (Nasdaq: HLT) celebrates several key growth milestones in the Branded Residential by Hilton portfolio, with Waldorf Astoria Residences actively engaged in new markets, achieving landmark sales results and reaching new construction heights. The momentum points to a robust demand for the globally recognized luxury brand and signals strong prospects for future growth.


This global appeal begins with Waldorf Astoria’s signature, *Sincerely Elegant Service* , brought into the context of a residence. Private homes, backed by the legacy of Waldorf Astoria and powered by Hilton’s hundred-plus year legacy of shaping the hospitality experience, offer operational excellence for a turnkey lifestyle.


Waldorf Astoria Residences Pompano Beach - Exterior


“Waldorf Astoria Residences represent one of the most compelling expressions of our luxury growth strategy, translating the brand’s legendary service, sense of place and hospitality expertise into private homes in some of the world’s most desirable destinations,” said Joe Haughney, vice president, Branded Residential by Hilton. “From landmark urban towers to oceanfront and mountain retreats, each residence is designed to reflect the character of its destination while delivering the unmistakable standards, service and sophistication of Waldorf Astoria.”


> "Waldorf Astoria Residences represent one of the most compelling expressions of our luxury growth strategy, translating the brand’s legendary service, sense of place and hospitality expertise into private homes in some of the world’s most desirable destinations."
>
>
> Joe Haughney
>
>
> Vice President, Branded Residential by Hilton


Beyond its service offerings, the design of each Waldorf Astoria Residence is highly considered, bringing the Waldorf Astoria world-class brand ethos to each location while responding to its specific contexts, culture and surroundings, often with some of the world’s top architects and designers as collaborators. The result is a portfolio that feels both distinctive and cohesive, reflecting both the heritage of Waldorf Astoria and the character of each destination. The current portfolio is set to nearly triple by 2030, reaching 34 properties and 3,498 units. Recent activity across Waldorf Astoria Residences reflects strong global expansion and delivery progress across key developments.


## Sales Milestones


**[Waldorf Astoria Residences Pompano Beach](https://waldorfastoriaresidencespompanobeach.com/)** , developed by Related Group and Merrimac Ventures, is the first standalone residential development in the portfolio. The 92-residence oceanfront tower celebrated its topping-off in May and is now 90% sold, with a record $18.1 million penthouse sale marking the highest residential transaction in Pompano Beach history. The brand’s arrival in Pompano Beach has helped catalyze the city’s transformation, raising the profile of a once quieter stretch of South Florida’s coastline. The development underscores continued demand for fully standalone residential offerings within the Hilton brand ecosystem. Completion is expected in summer 2027.


-
-


Waldorf Astoria Residences St. Petersburg - Living Room - Credit - ARX Creative (L) & Waldorf Astoria Residences Sarasota - Primary Bedroom (R)


On Florida’s West Coast, **[Waldorf Astoria Residences St. Petersburg](https://waresidencesstpetersburg.com/)** , **** a landmark 50-story tower introducing the brand to the region, recently surpassed $200M in sales and celebrated a record-breaking penthouse sale which was the highest in Tampa Bay history at $27 million. The development is scheduled for completion in 2030 and offers an advanced residential experience defined by expansive layouts, refined finishes and a full suite of resort-style amenities. Sales have commenced at **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Sarasota](https://waresidencessarasota.com/)** on Florida’s Gulf Coast, which will become the tallest building in downtown Sarasota. Set for occupancy in 2029, the property will offer coveted wellness and outdoor living spaces for residents. Both projects expand Hilton’s footprint in growing luxury markets and reflect continued demand for branded residential offerings in culturally rich destinations.


Waldorf Astoria Residences Yas Island – Pool - Credit - ALDAR


In Abu Dhabi, **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Yas](https://www.waldorfastoriaresidencesyas.com/en)** , a collection of homes offering sweeping waterfront and golf course views, sold out on launch day, reinforcing the appeal of Hilton’s branded residential offering in the region. Across the UAE, continued expansion and milestone transactions further reflect this momentum, with the signing of **Waldorf Astoria Residences Dubai Islands** adding to Dubai’s dynamic branded residential landscape, and a record‑breaking penthouse sale at **Waldorf Astoria Residences Ras Al Khaimah** demonstrating sustained demand for luxury branded living.


> "Waldorf Astoria’s longstanding legacy in luxury hospitality gives the brand a distinctive position in the residential sector, and the response to our developments reflects its enduring resonance among discerning buyers who seek not only an extraordinary home, but a lasting connection to a name synonymous with elegance, hospitality and timeless luxury."
>
>
> Dan Wakeling
>
>
> Vice President, Development, Luxury & Residences, EMEA, Hilton


“Waldorf Astoria’s longstanding legacy in luxury hospitality gives the brand a distinctive position in the residential sector, and the response to our developments reflects its enduring resonance among discerning buyers who seek not only an extraordinary home, but a lasting connection to a name synonymous with elegance, hospitality and timeless luxury," said Dan Wakeling, vice president, Development, Luxury & Residences, EMEA, Hilton. "Across EMEA and beyond, we are witnessing growing demand from owners and developers eager to create truly distinctive residential offerings, underpinned by Hilton’s global platform, unparalleled expertise and unwavering commitment to delivering world-class hospitality and branded living experiences. With significant opportunity across established and emerging luxury destinations, we are excited to build on this momentum and bring Waldorf Astoria Residences to more remarkable locations across the region.”


## New Market Entries


In the Americas, Hilton announced the signing of **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Guadalajara](https://www.waldorfastoriaresidencesguadalajara.com/)** , **** the first standalone Waldorf Astoria branded residence in Mexico, the Caribbean and Latin America. With 53% of residences sold and construction underway, the development is already demonstrating strong momentum. Designed by global architecture firm Gensler, with interiors by Cuaik Architects, the collection of private homes will set a new benchmark for luxury real estate in the region. Completion is expected in winter 2029.


Waldorf Astoria Residences Guadalajara - Exterior Facade and Entrance


**[Waldorf Astoria Residences Deer Valley](https://waresidencesdeervalley.com/)** has launched sales and is slated to open in 2028, bringing an elevated residential experience to the renowned mountain community of Deer Valley East Village in Utah, the first major public alpine ski resort developed in North America in over 40 years. Residents will enjoy coveted offerings like ski-in, ski-out access paired with the brand’s signature service. The excitement growing around the development reflects the continued demand for branded homes in leading, year-round leisure markets.


Additional new market entries include **[Waldorf Astoria Residences San Miguel de Allende](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-waldorf-astoria-san-miguel-de-allende-signing)** slated to debut in Mexico in 2027, introducing 24 branded residences in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage city, and offering luxury ownership in one of the country’s most celebrated cultural destinations. Set to open in 2030, **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Turks and Caicos Dellis Cay](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-continues-to-expand-luxury-portfolio-with-the-signing-of-waldorf-astoria-turks-and-caicos-dellis-cay)** will bring Waldorf Astoria’s signature service and sophisticated island living to the Caribbean, with 65 luxury residences across beachfront and ocean villas and condominiums. **Waldorf Astoria Residences Texas Hill Country** will bring the brand’s signature service to Fredericksburg, offering private residences and multi-bedroom resort villas with access to a luxury spa, culinary experiences, concierge services and world-class amenities—all rooted in the region’s wine country and authentic Texas character.


Across EMEA, Waldorf Astoria Residences continue to demonstrate strong demand across key markets. Opening in late 2026 in Greece, **Waldorf Astoria Residences Athens The Ilisian** will be located on the top four floors of the tower housing the newly opened **[Conrad Athens The Ilisian](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/athgrci-conrad-athens-the-ilisian/)** , **** bringing two distinct brand expressions together in one destination, each shaped by its own design identity and shared hospitality foundation. In Spain, Hilton has announced the signing of **Waldorf Astoria Residences Marbella** **in Málaga Province** , which will introduce 120 branded residences alongside a luxury resort, further expanding the brand’s presence across key Mediterranean destinations.


In APAC, **Waldorf Astoria Residences Tokyo Nihonbashi** marks the brand’s first residential project in Tokyo, developed by Mitsui Fudosan Residential in collaboration with Hilton within Tokyo Midtown Nihonbashi, a planned mixed-use development that will include office and retail spaces. All 71 residences will offer direct access to hotel services and dedicated amenities along with seamless transit connectivity to Nihonbashi and Tokyo Station. Residential tenancy is expected to begin fall 2027.


## Construction Momentum


**[Waldorf Astoria Residences Costa Rica Punta Cacique](https://waldorfastoriaresidencescostarica.com/)** has unveiled its first completed Estate Homes, a limited collection of 22 grand cliffside residences set atop the Cacique Peninsula in Guanacaste and just beyond the Nicoya Peninsula, one of the world's five Blue Zones. Created by an acclaimed team of architects, planners, and landscape designers, including Garnier Arquitectos, RoblesArq, Gensler, and EDSA, the residences span up to 11,027 square feet with panoramic views across the Gulf of Papagayo to the Pacific, and are the first Waldorf Astoria-branded private residences in the 600-acre Punta Cacique master-planned community. Priced from mid-$7 million to more than $11.750 million and now over 50% sold, the Estate Homes join the recently opened Waldorf Astoria resort and the sold-out Coral Residences as the community continues its multi-phase growth.


Waldorf Astoria Residences Miami - Penthouse Kitchen


In Miami, **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Miami](https://www.waldorfresidencesmiami.com/)** continues strong sales momentum and is set to become the tallest residential building on the East Coast outside of New York City upon completion in 2028. The 100-story tower, designed by globally renowned architect Carlos Ott in collaboration with Sieger Suarez Architects, is brought to life by signature offerings including the brand’s iconic Peacock Alley. Construction is ongoing, with 89 floors currently poured.


Waldorf Astoria Residences Denver Cherry Creek – Exterior - Credit - ARX Creative


Developed by PMG, **[Waldorf Astoria Residences Denver Cherry Creek](https://waldorfastoriacherrycreekresidences.com/)** set a benchmark for luxury living in Colorado as the state's first Waldorf Astoria-branded property. With construction underway (set to be completed in 2028) and over 75% of the residences sold, the project further expands Hilton’s presence in the highly desirable Mountain West destination.


Branded Residential by Hilton developments are defined by collaborations with leading global architects and designers, such as **Foster + Partners, Frank Gehry, Pierre-Yves Rochon** and **Rockwell Group, Carlos Ott.** These partnerships help shape **** residences that balance highly sought-after design with long-term livability while staying closely connected to their surroundings.


Hilton’s branded residential pipeline continues to grow across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Latin America, with additional announcements expected throughout 2026 and beyond.


Explore the latest Branded Residential by Hilton news, milestones, and property announcements at ****[Stories From Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/branded-residential-by-hilton) **.**


##### FAQ: Waldorf Astoria Residences Portfolio Set to Nearly Triple by 2030


22 Waldorf Astoria Residences are currently in the pipeline.


Across the Americas, new Waldorf Astoria Residences are underway in Guadalajara and San Miguel de Allende, Mexico; Punta Cacique, Costa Rica; Dellis Cay, Turks and Caicos; and several U.S. destinations, including Denver Cherry Creek, Miami, Pompano Beach, St. Petersburg, Deer Valley, Sarasota and Texas Hill Country. Internationally, new residences are planned in Athens, Marbella, Tokyo, Dubai Islands, Yas Island and Ras Al Khaimah, extending the portfolio across Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.


Brand loyalists will now be able to live at a Waldorf Astoria in more of the world’s most exciting destinations, designed by some of the world’s most celebrated architects and designers. Enjoying a lifestyle embodying The Greatest of Them All, with five-star service, amenities and attention to detail brought home.

## About Hilton

Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone. ## About Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts


[Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/waldorf-astoria/) is an award-winning portfolio of 40 iconic properties, each embodying a distinct sense of place through sincerely elegant service, one-of-a-kind experiences and culinary mastery in landmark destinations around the world. The highly anticipated reopening of Waldorf Astoria New York marked a defining moment for the brand - reintroducing a legend while ushering in a new era of luxury. Inspired by their timeless environments, Waldorf Astoria hotels deliver an effortless experience seamlessly, creating a true sense of place for guests through stunning architecture, the famous Peacock Alley, refined art collections, Michelin-starred dining and elevated in-room amenities. In addition to the brand’s world-class hotel offerings, Waldorf Astoria boasts a global residential portfolio that provides the comfort of a private home combined with unsurpassed amenities and high-touch service. Waldorf Astoria is part of Hilton, a leading global hospitality company. ## About Branded Residential by Hilton


Branded Residential by Hilton extends the light and warmth of hospitality for which Hilton is known worldwide, creating opportunities to own real estate at globally renowned properties in the world’s most desirable addresses. The portfolio delivers elevated offerings from estate homes in resort settings to private residences in iconic urban cities, rooted in a philosophy of care and attention to the resident experience across categories, with commercial success across all market segments, from luxury to lifestyle and beyond. With 13 world-class brands spanning 100 residences trading and pipeline, Branded Residential by Hilton brings Hilton’s century of influence and expertise in global hospitality to a culturally-savvy, design-forward and diverse, best-in-class portfolio. Learn more at[hiltonbrandedresidences.com](https://hiltonbrandedresidences.com/) .
